public_rationale: On April 4, 2024, two days before the post, Grok wrote a false headline, 'Iran Strikes Tel Aviv with Heavy Missiles,' and X promoted it in its trending news section. Mashable reported this was the first time X packaged Grok's misinformation as a real news story and pushed it to its entire user base. The AI Incident Database logged it as an incident. A day later Grok reportedly turned joke posts into a news-style summary. The false Iran claim started with users, but Grok gave it an official-looking headline and platform-wide reach. That fits the plain reading of making the problem worse.
limitations: The false Iran story began with user posts; Grok's added effect on spread is not separately measured.
Reach figures for the Grok headline are not given in the cited sources.
